_comment: What to search for, once you have decided where.
Until now the query was a free-text box: one word, one search, and
whatever you happened to think of. That biases the whole pipeline toward
cafés, because cafés are what comes to mind. The trades below are often
better leads and almost never get typed in.
`queries` are the terms actually sent to the map provider. Several per
industry because providers match on their own category names, and a
plumber is filed under 'plumber' in one place and 'plumbing service' in
another. Duplicates across queries are collapsed on place_id.
`why` is the reason this trade is worth the call — the same discipline as
`note` in scout_areas.json. If you cannot write one, do not add the row.
`visitor_led` marks trades whose customers are strangers choosing from a
map. Those are the ones where a broken site costs a booking tonight. The
rest sell to locals and repeat customers, where the site matters less and
the pitch has to be different.

industries.label: Cafés & coffee
industries.why: Chosen off a map by someone standing on the street; photos and hours decide it

industries.label: Restaurants
industries.why: Menu and booking link are the whole shopfront for a visitor

industries.label: Accommodation
industries.why: Booked entirely online, often weeks ahead; a bad site loses the whole stay

industries.label: Bakeries & patisserie
industries.why: Impulse trade driven by photos and opening hours

industries.label: Bars & breweries
industries.why: Events and what's on tap change weekly and are usually stale online

industries.label: Wineries & cellar doors
industries.why: Sell direct at high margin; tastings and shipping both run through the site

industries.label: Tours & activities
industries.why: Pure online purchase, no walk-ins; the booking flow is the business

industries.label: Spa & wellness
industries.why: Appointment-led, and the site carries the price list and the mood

industries.label: Hair & beauty
industries.why: Bookings move online first in this trade; many are still phone-only

industries.label: Gyms & studios
industries.why: Timetable and membership pricing are what a prospect comes to check

industries.label: Trades & home services
industries.why: High job value, fierce local search competition, and rarely a real site

industries.label: Automotive
industries.why: Found by search in an emergency; hours and location have to be right

industries.label: Independent retail
industries.why: Competing with online; a shop with no site is invisible outside the street

industries.label: Professional services
industries.why: Credibility purchase — a dated site actively costs them enquiries

industries.label: Allied health
industries.why: Online booking is now expected; many still run on a template from 2014

industries.label: Pet services
industries.why: Booking-led and highly local; owners research before trusting anyone
